meta.title: Masār — a practice-first learning platform
meta.description: A learning platform where a lesson can be published at three defined depths and assessment is built from a blueprint rather than a pile of questions.

hero.title: Masār
hero.body: One lesson can be published at three defined depths, assessment is built from a blueprint rather than a pile of questions, and the content pipeline that produces the lessons ships in this repository with its own quality gate.

l1.name: L1 — Structured publishing
l1.body: The source material, professionally structured into the platform.

l2.name: L2 — Interactive lesson
l2.body: Worked examples, knowledge checks, and scenarios with consequences.

l3.name: L3 — Applied practice
l3.body: A rehearsal of a real job task, scored against a published rubric.

disclaimer: A self-initiated demonstration platform. Not affiliated with, or recognized by, any certification body. All data is fictional training data. Not medical, billing, clinical, legal or regulatory advice.
